Our ALBIES AUCTION is now LIVE!

Now’s your chance to bid on amazing experiences, fun getaways, and exclusive items from the Maysles Films Archive – all while supporting Maysles Documentary Center. We’ll be adding more items in the lead-up to the Albies, so keep checking back!  Bidding closes at 11:45pm on Sunday, September 27th, so don’t wait until the last minute!

And if you haven’t gotten your tickets to the The Albies or the After Party, they’re still available – but time is running out. Get your tickets today!

Maysles Documentary Center is a Harlem-based nonprofit organization committed to community, education, and documentary film. We use filmmaking to amplify and expand under-represented artists and narratives, while empowering young filmmakers in creative self-expression, communicating ideas, and advocating needs.
